page: List of Figures (PDF p. 8–10, printed p. iv–vi)
evidence: List of Figures prints: 'P.1 The architect's decision loop — the book's spine . . . xii'; '2.2 Prefill and decode split by the roofline ridge . . . . . 31' [sic — actual page 32]; '6.1 The metric hierarchy as a diagnostic chain [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] . . . . . . . 125'; '7.1 Grouped-Query Attention cuts per-token KV . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 151'. In the rendered body the Figure 2.2 caption appears on the page displaying '31' (PDF p. 52); the Figure 6.1 caption appears on the page displaying '124' (PDF p. 144); the Figure 7.1 caption appears on the page displaying '150' (PDF p. 153); the Preface Figure P.1 caption appears on the page displaying 'xii' but the figure content spans the prior page displaying 'xii' [sic — confirmed on PDF p. 16].
issue: The List of Figures page index is systematically off by one for at least the entries P.1, 2.2, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 7.2, 7.5, 7.7, 7.8 (and likely many others in chapters 8–26): each entry points to the page AFTER the one on which the figure and its caption actually appear. Earlier entries (1.1 at p. 10, 1.2 at p. 11, 2.1 at p. 19, P.2 at p. xiii) are correct, so the index is internally inconsistent — a reader using it to navigate will consistently land one page too late for many figures. The TOC introduction also promises 'Every figure the book numbers' as an accurate index.
fix_instruction: Decrement every affected page number in the List of Figures by 1 (or re-derive all entries from the typesetting source) so each entry matches the page on which the figure's caption actually falls. Re-run the check for every entry after the typeset layout changes.

evidence: Printed p. 56, Table 2-2 scope note: "Basis of these intensity figures, so the chapters reconcile:* every value here divides the linear-term prefill FLOPs, 2NL, by weight bytes. Adding the attention FLOPs to the numerator instead raises the weight-only value to ~10.8K FLOP/byte (the figure Ch 6, Table 6-1 quotes), while adding the ~24 GB KV write to the denominator is the correction that gives ~7,850."
issue: Internal contradiction: the sentence claims 'every value here divides the linear-term prefill FLOPs, 2NL, by weight bytes' and then attributes ~7,850 FOP/byte to 'adding the ~24 GB KV write to the denominator.' But 1.29 PFLOP ÷ (140 GB + 24.1 GB) = 1.29e15 ÷ 1.641e11 ≈ 7,860 FLOP/byte — this divides by (weight + KV) bytes, NOT by weight bytes alone. The very next sentence says 'The two corrections act on different terms, so they are not competing estimates; all three bases sit far to the right of the ~295 ridge,' which acknowledges the three values use different bases — directly contradicting the earlier claim that 'every value here' shares one basis. A reader following the stated methodology (linear FLOPs ÷ weight bytes = 9,200) cannot reproduce 7,850.
fix_instruction: Rewrite the basis note to state explicitly which numerator and which denominator produce each of the three values: (i) 9,200 = linear FLOPs ÷ weight bytes; (ii) 10,800 = (linear + attention) FLOPs ÷ weight bytes; (iii) 7,850 = linear FLOPs ÷ (weight + KV) bytes. Remove the claim that 'every value here' divides by weight bytes alone.

evidence: Printed p. xviii, Preface: "TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill, where tokenization/transfer counts as one combined term. … The same formula is quoted verbatim in §4.3, and the ~1.08 s prefill residual used in §2.3 is the prefill term of that two-term budget (retrieval + prefill)."
issue: Wrong cross-reference. The four-term formula TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill is stated in Ch. 2 §2.1 (printed p. 17) and in Ch. 4 §4.3 only the two-term budget (retrieval ~120 ms + prefill ~1.08 s), NOT the four-term formula, appears. Verbatim from printed p. 89 (Ch. 4 §4.3): 'TTFT (time-to-first-token): budget of 1.2 s, comprising retrieval (~120 ms …) + prefill — budget cap 1.08 s.' The sentence 'The same formula is quoted verbatim in §4.3' is factually false: §4.3 quotes a two-term budget, not the four-term formula.
fix_instruction: Change the cross-reference from '§4.3' to 'Ch. 2 §2.1' (where the four-term formula is stated), or rewrite the sentence to say that §4.3 uses a two-term budget derived from the four-term formula, not that it quotes the formula verbatim.
